name: agentsvc.io
description: 122 pay-per-call tools for AI agents over one Streamable HTTP endpoint: a task agent that runs many tools in one call, speech to text, web scraping and crawling to Markdown, screenshots, invoice extraction, company checks (LEI, VAT, sanctions), token pre-trade checks, scam message and prompt injection detection, IOTA notarization, and page, token and wallet watches with webhooks. No account or API key: tool calls are paid with USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon or Arbitrum via x402 inside tools/call; calls with the example input are free.
